entities.name: Christian Bergström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Per Christian Bergström is a former tennis player from Sweden, who turned professional in 1985. He did not win any titles during his career, but reached three singles quarter-finals in Grand Slam tournaments: Wimbledon and Australian Open (1993). The right-hander reached his highest individual ranking on the ATP Tour on 27 January 1992, when he became World No. 32.

entities.name: Christian Bergström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Per Christian Bergström is a former tennis player from Sweden, who turned professional in 1985. He did not win any titles during his career, but reached three singles quarter-finals in Grand Slam tournaments: Wimbledon and Australian Open (1993). The right-hander reached his highest individual ranking on the ATP Tour on 27 January 1992, when he became World No. 32.
